data.text: Luke, my answer is no to 13 tons, but thank you for offering to sacrifice your own income. I’ll choose 10 this month. Fishing has supported my family, and I want it to keep supporting all five of ours—not just give some of us a bigger payday now. With Jack and Emma supporting 10 each, we have a straightforward plan that keeps the lake full. Luke, will you join us at 10 rather than go without? John, can you commit to 10 as well?
